newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 14.

text.p: Mitsubishi Rayon Co Ltd plans to spend about seven billion yen to increase its production capacity of carbon fiber by 80 percent to 3,400 tonnes annually by spring 1998.

Rohm Co Ltd is expected to post a record-high consolidated net profit of 42 billion yen in the year to March 1997, up 10 percent from the prior year, compared with a forecast of a three percent drop, reflecting strong sales of

FamilyMart Co Ltd is expected to see a 12 percent increase in its pre-tax profit to nearly 22.5 billion yen in the year to February 1997, reflecting an increase in the number of stores and favourable sales of prepared foods. Net profit was forecast at 11.6 billion yen, up five percent.
